evidence_items.publisher: Reuters (via The Star), citing The Information

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI said it burned $2.5 billion, in large part due to its research and development costs for developing artificial intelligence and for running ChatGPT

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's cash burn for all of January to June 2025 was $2.5 billion, so June alone was at most about $2.5 billion. For two months to reach $10 billion, July and early August would need $7.5 billion or more. The full-year target in e2 rules that out.

inputs: Full-year 2025 cash-burn target: $8.5 billion (e2), reported in late September 2025, after June to August had passed
derived.formula: Assuming monthly burn is never negative, burn in any two-month window of 2025 is at most the full-year burn (about $8.5 billion), which is below $10 billion. Second-half burn implied by the target is 8.5 − 2.5 = $6.0 billion for six months.
derived.rounding: Billions of US dollars, one decimal place

evidence_items.publisher: Reuters (via The Star), citing The Information

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI looks to meet its full-year revenue target of $13 billion and a cash-burn target of $8.5 billion

evidence_items.explanation: In late September 2025, with the June to August months already known, OpenAI was reported to be on track for $8.5 billion of cash burn for the whole year. That is less than the $10 billion claimed for two months.

evidence_items.locator: paragraph beginning 'According to a report published last month'

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI during the first half of 2025 collected $4.3 billion in revenue while still posting a net loss of $13.5 billion during that six month period.

evidence_items.explanation: The accounting net loss was much larger than cash burn. The same article says more than half of it came from remeasuring convertible interests, a non-cash item. Even this six-month loss works out to about $4.5 billion per two months on average. Net loss is not cash burn.

evidence_items.locator: section before 'The key 2025 figures at a glance'

receipt.public_excerpt: total costs and expenses reached $34 billion, producing an operating loss of $20.92 billion.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's full-year 2025 operating loss, from leaked statements, was about $20.9 billion, an average of about $3.5 billion per two months. Even this broader measure does not suggest $10 billion in the June to July window.

unresolved_gaps: No reported figure covers exactly June to early August 2025. The result rests on bounding figures for the first half and the full year.
The $8.5 billion full-year figure is a target reported in September, not an audited actual.
The available_at date for e4 is approximate. The item is context only.
